description: Smart-search filters for the Project Cost Detail tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. Not offered: customerName, requestNumber, yardLocation (dropped by request — free-text q still spans all three). Project (projectNumber) and Equipment (equipmentNumber) re-added by request for chip-set parity with the other report tabs.
